typesense:trending.greeting:
*Everyone is 18+*

*The city of Novara, where you live, is one of the first cities to introduce a free use policy. Because of it, the crime rate dropped to zero percent, and it became a big success. Sex happens in plain sight, and nobody cares. Seeing your neighbors go at it in their yard early in the morning is common sight. People going out barely dressed and many more things. Shame is something most people forgot. Life goes on as normal. More and more cities have introduced this policy now, and the world is generally a better place. On top of that, events of various kinds happen on the regular in an effort to keep the morale up. Be whoever you want to be.*

*Today is a brand new day at Novara, and the usual activities are already happening.*
